senses.gloss:
बोध बोध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. बुध्), know-
ing, understanding; (अस्), m. perception, apprehen-
sion, observation, conception, thought; knowledge,
understanding, wisdom, intellect, sense, intelligence
[cf. दुर्-ब्˚, विपरीत-ब्˚]; waking, becoming awake,
waking state, (बोधम् प्र-या, to become awake,
wake up; said of a spell, i. e. to begin to take effect);
the opening of blossom, bloom; making known,
informing, instructing; awakening, arousing; a de-
signation, epithet; Knowledge personified as the son
of Buddhi; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; of a district.
—बोध-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing knowledge; one
who informs or teaches, a teacher; one who wakens
or rouses; (अस्), m. ‘an awakener,’ a minstrel who
wakes a prince or chief in the morning with music.
—बोध-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, attainable by the intel-
lect, intelligible, within the compass of the understand-
ing.
—बोध-घनाचार्य (˚न-आच्˚), अस्, m., N. of
a teacher.
—बोध-चित्त-विवरण, अम्, n., N. of a
Buddhist work; (perhaps wrongly for बोधि-चित्त-
विवरण.)
—बोध-तस्, ind. through wisdom or
understanding.
—बोध-धिषण, अस्, m. one
whose intellect is knowledge (an epithet of the Su-
preme Being ?).
—बोध-पूर्वम्, ind. knowingly,
consciously; अ-ब्˚, unconsciously.
—बोध-पृथ्वी-
धर, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
—बोध-वासर,
अस्, m. ‘the day of waking,’ the eleventh day in the
light half of the month Kārttika (in which Viṣṇu
awakes from his sleep; = बोधनी).
—बोध-सुधा-
कर (˚धा-आक्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Vedānta work.
—बो-
धातीत (˚ध-अत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, beyond the reach of
the understanding.
—बोधात्मन् (˚ध-आत्˚), आ, m.
(with Jainas) the intelligent and sentient soul.
—बो-
धानन्द-घन (˚ध-आन्˚), अस्, m., N. of a
preceptor; [cf. बोध-घनाचार्य.]
—बोधार-
ण्य-यति (˚ध-अर्˚), इस्, m., N. of a preceptor.

बोधक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), causing to
know, apprising, informing, instructing, explaining,
teaching, an instructor, teacher [cf. बाल-ब्˚]; de-
noting, indicating, signifying; arousing, awaking;
(अस्), m. a spy, informer; N. of a man; (आस्), m.
pl., N. of his descendants.
—बोधक-त्व, अम्, n.
the state of causing to know, giving information or
instruction; capability of instructing.

बोधन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the simple rt. and fr. the
Caus.), making known, informing, explaining, teach-
ing, instructing, enlightening [cf. बाल-बोधनी];
wakening, rousing, exciting; kindling, inflaming; (अस्),
m. the planet Mercury; N. of a mountain; (ई), f. intel-
lect, understanding, knowledge; ‘the day of awaking,’
an epithet of the eleventh day in the light half of the
month Kārttika on which Viṣṇu awakes from his
sleep [cf. उत्थानैकादशी]; long pepper; (अम्),
n. observing, marking, perceiving; causing to per-
ceive or know, instructing, teaching; signifying,
denoting, indicating; making attentive; waking,
being awake; causing to wake, awakening, rousing,
arousing; burning incense (regarded as the ‘awaken-
[]
ing’ of a perfume); ‘the awaking of Durgā,’ N. of
a festival on the ninth day of the dark half of the
month Bhādra.
—बोधन-मन्त्र, अस्, m., N. of
a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarvasva.

बोधान, अस्, आ, अम्, prudent, clever; (अस्), m. a
prudent man; an epithet of Bṛhas-pati; [cf. बु-
धान.]

बोधनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be known or under-
stood, intelligible, to be apprehended; to be made
known or explained.

बोधन्-मनस्, Ved. a various reading for बो-
धिन्-मनस्, q. v.

बोधयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to know, in-
forming, apprising, teaching; causing to wake, wak-
ening, rousing.

बोधयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to under-
stand, to be made acquainted with, to be informed
of (with acc.; cf. बोधितव्य below).

बोधयितृ, ता, m. one who causes to know, a
teacher, preceptor; a waker, awakener.

बोधयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Caus.), wishing
to awaken, intending to arouse.

बोधायन, अस्, m., N. of a teacher and author
of the Brahma-sūtra-vṛtti, a philosophical work.

बोधि, इस्, m. (with Buddhists and Jainas) perfect
wisdom (by which a man becomes a Buddha or
Jina); the illuminated or enlightened intellect of a
Buddha [cf. देव-ब्˚]; the tree under which perfect
wisdom is attained or under which a man becomes
a Buddha, the sacred fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa [cf.
बोधि-तरु]; an epithet of Buddha; N. of one of
the thirty-four Jātakas of Buddha; ‘the wakener,’ a
cock; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a people [cf. बोध,
बौधि]; (इस्, इस्, इ), wise, learned (?).
—बोधि-
चित्त-विवरण, अम्, n., N. of a work mentioned in
the Sarva-darśana-saṅgraha.
—बोधि-तरु, उस्, or
बोधि-द्रुम, अस्, m. ‘tree of wisdom,’ the sacred
fig-tree under which perfect knowledge is obtained.
—बोधि-द, अस्, m. (with Jainas) an Arhat.
—बो-
धि-धन, अस्, m., see the next.
—बोधि-धर्म,
अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist patriarch whose original
name was Bodhi-dhana.
—बोधि-भद्र, अस्, m., N.
of a Buddhist teacher.
—बोधि-मण्ड, N. of a seat
which was said to have risen out of the earth under the
sacred fig-tree when Śākya-muni attained to Bodhi or
perfect wisdom; = बोधि-मण्डल.
—बोधि-मण्-
डल, अम्, n., N. of the place where Śākya-muni at-
tained to Bodhi or perfect wisdom.
—बोधि-वृक्ष,
अस्, m. = बोधि-तरु.
—बोधि-सङ्घाराम (˚घ-
आर्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist monastery.
—बोधि-
सत्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose essence is wisdom;
(अस्), m. (with Buddhists) ‘one who has Bodhi or
perfect wisdom as his essence,’ one who is on the way
to the attainment of perfect knowledge when he has
only one birth or certain births to undergo before ob-
taining the state of a supreme Buddha and then Nir-
vāṇa [cf. देव-ब्˚]; a title of the Buddha κατ’ ἐξοχήν.
—बोधिसत्त्व-चर्यावतार (˚य-अव्˚) and बोधि-
सत्त्व-पक्षनिर्देश, अस्, m. and बोधिसत्त्व-पि-
टक, N. of Buddhist works.
—बोधिसत्त्व-ता, f. the
state of one who is on the way to attain perfect wisdom.
—बोधिसत्त्व-बुद्धानुस्मृति-समाधि (˚ध-
अन्˚), इस्, m., N. of a Buddhist Sūtra work.
—बोधि-
सत्त्व-भूमि, इस्, f., N. of a Buddhist work.
—बो-
धिसत्त्व-समुच्चया, f., N. of a Buddhist goddess.
—बोधिसत्त्वावदान-कल्प-लता (˚व-अव्˚), f.,
N. of a collection of Buddhist legends.
—बोध्य्-
अङ्ग, अम्, n. an element or condition of the state
of Bodhi or perfect knowledge.

बोधित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), made known,
apprised, explained, informed, instructed.

बोधितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), to be
made known, to be imparted or communicated.

बोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. the simple rt. and fr. the
Caus.), knowing, familiar with; causing to perceive
or know; making known, teaching, revealing [cf.
तत्त्व-बोधिनी]; arousing, awakening [cf. ज्ञान-
बोधिनी].

बोधिन्-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (according to the Pada-
pāṭha fr. a form बोधित् + मनस्), Ved. one whose
[]
mind is awake, watchful, attentive (Sāy. = बुध्य-
मान-मनस्क).
बोधिल, अस्, m. (fr. बोधि), N. of a man.

बोधेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a school; [cf. अद्धा-
ब्˚, बौधेय.]

बोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be known or understood,
knowable; perceivable, intelligible, to be appre-
hended; to be informed or instructed, to be admon-
ished; to be declared or explained; to be waked; (अस्),
m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
—बोध्य-गीता, f., N. of the 178th
chapter of the Śānti-parvan of the Mahā-bhārata.
